name: Mystics of Sapphia
source:
You play as a princess who recently escaped an assassination attempt by a charm your mother placed on your best friend.
The charm causes both of your consciousness to swap and now you are hiding in your friend's body. You need find a way to reclaim
your right as heir to throne, however it will prove difficult given that look like someone else and a maid at that. Maybe seeking the aid
of one of three mystics who can help you take control of your kingdom. That is... if you don't get distracted by romance.

[From [url=https://lusciousspiritstudio.deviantart.com/art/Mystic-Ad-701350331]DeviantART[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一位公主，最近因母亲对你最好的朋友施的咒语而逃脱了一次暗杀企图。
魅力导致你们双方的意识交换，现在你躲在你朋友的身体里。你需要找到一种方法来回收
你作为王位继承人的权利，但是考虑到看起来像其他人和女仆，这将被证明是困难的。也许寻求帮助
三位神秘主义者之一，可以帮助你控制你的王国。也就是说……如果你不被浪漫分心的话。

[来自[url=https://lusciousspiritstudio.deviantart.com/art/Mystic-Ad-701350331]DeviantART[/url]]
